in_sanskrit.name: Jainuddin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Religious, Jain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jainuddin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jainuddin is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaina' which means 'Religious' and 'uddin' which means 'Benefactor'. This name is used to honor someone who is deeply religious and is also a benefactor to others. It is a beautiful name for a baby boy in the Hindu community.
